items.title: File Widerspruch against Kontenklärung decision
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 27.11.2025, sent by post from a German social-insurance authority. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 01.12.2025 (no weekend shift applies to this delivery rule). The one-month objection period of § 84 Abs. 1 SGG starts the following day (§ 26 Abs. 1 SGB X, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, i.e. Thu 01.01.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). That day is a public holiday (Neujahr), so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next working day, Fri 02.01.2026.
